Emotions give us information and energy. They are signals, not commands.

You never need to share private details to take part in this lesson.

## What do emotions do?

### 1. They motivate us

Emotions prepare us to act.

### 2. They communicate to us

They point to what matters, what feels unsafe, or what needs attention.

### 3. They communicate to others

People read our face, voice, posture, and actions. Design communicates in similar ways through colour, type, images, shapes, spacing, and contrast.

## Don't let the feed farm you

The feed picks what you see.

It makes money when you keep scrolling.

**Look up. Name what you feel. Pick your own move.**

## Explore an emotion

| Emotion | What it does | What we can do |
|---|---|---|
| [Fear and anxiety](fear-anxiety.qmd) | Warns us about danger or uncertainty and prepares us to escape, avoid, or freeze. | Get safe, check the facts, ask for support, then take one brave step if it is safe. |
| [Anger](anger.qmd) | Gives us energy when a goal is blocked, something feels unfair, or a boundary is crossed. | Pause, check the facts, state the boundary, and choose useful action or repair. |
| [Disgust](disgust.qmd) | Pushes us away from something that may be unsafe, harmful, or against our values. | Name the problem, check the evidence, step back, and reject harm without attacking a person. |
| [Envy](envy.qmd) | Shows us something another person has that we may want for ourselves. | Name what you want and turn comparison into a healthy goal. |
| [Jealousy](jealousy.qmd) | Warns us that we may lose a relationship, role, place, or attention. | Check the facts, ask directly, name what you need, and build trust. |
| [Guilt](guilt.qmd) | Tells us our behaviour may not match our values or may have hurt someone. | Acknowledge it, repair the harm, change the behaviour, and let go. |
| [Shame](shame.qmd) | Makes us want to hide when we feel exposed, rejected, or wrong as a person. | Check the facts, separate the action from your identity, repair if needed, and talk to someone safe. |
| [Happiness](happiness.qmd) | Draws us toward people and actions that feel rewarding, meaningful, or successful. | Notice the win, enjoy it, share it, and keep doing what works. |
| [Love](love.qmd) | Connects us to people, places, ideas, values, and communities that matter. | Show care, respect boundaries, offer useful support, and let others care for you. |
| [Sadness](sadness.qmd) | Slows us down when something is lost, ends, or matters deeply. | Name the loss, rest, reach out, and take one small action when ready. |

## What can we do with an emotion?

1. **Name it to tame it.** What am I feeling?
2. **Feel it to heal it.** Notice the feeling without acting right away.
3. **Check the facts.** What is happening? What does the emotion make me want to do?
4. **Choose the next action.** What response will help?

## Use emotions in your design

Choose three emotions you want people to feel when they see your personal brand.

For each emotion, choose one design move using colour, type, images, shapes, spacing, or contrast.
